name: DOF-GS
definition: A 3DGS-based framework that incorporates a finite-aperture camera model for modeling and rendering depth-of-field effects, enabling post-capture DOF control (aperture and focal distance adjustment) and defocus rendering from multi-view defocused images.
summary: DOF-GS is a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that enables post-capture depth-of-field control by blurring individual Gaussians based on learnable Circle-of-Confusion cues, offering efficient and differentiable aperture adjustment.
